plugins.name: coding-conventions
plugins.description: General and language-specific coding conventions, enforced before edits via rules (Cursor) and hooks (Claude).

plugins.name: dual-platform-agents
plugins.description: Wire repo-level agent instructions, skills and agent definitions for both Cursor and Claude Code (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .agents/, .claude/), enforced via rules (Cursor) and hooks (Claude).

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Conventional commit messages generated from the diff, with intelligent staging.

plugins.name: create-pull-request
plugins.description: Create or update GitHub pull requests that follow the repo's PR template, with a Conventional Commits title and an optional pre-push code review. Enforced via rules (Cursor) and hooks (Claude).

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Read-only structured code review against conventions skills and the repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and .greptile/ rules, split into blocking issues and suggestions.

plugins.name: address-greptile-reviews
plugins.description: Triage, verify and resolve Greptile PR review feedback — scores, inline comments, thrashing and evidence-backed pushback.
